subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should corrupted Telegram/session-store JSON recovery be diagnostic-only, backup-first explicit reset, or automatic quarantine on load?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the recovery mode changes operator control and persisted session continuity, and it overlaps with generic session-store recovery work.

options.title: Diagnostic plus explicit reset
options.body: Status or doctor reports file health and points to a backup-first reset command while keeping destructive action operator-controlled.

options.title: Diagnostic only
options.body: Status or doctor reports the bad state and safe manual steps, leaving reset automation for a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Automatic quarantine
options.body: Gateway moves the bad artifact aside and recreates state on load, maximizing recovery but taking the largest data-continuity risk.

recommendation.title: Diagnostic plus explicit reset
recommendation.body: Status or doctor reports file health and points to a backup-first reset command while keeping destructive action operator-controlled.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal combines Telegram status diagnostics and session-store ownership around the affected surfaces.
